note: Source-derived constants from PathofDust (Rust). Per-tier affix values are the code defaults from affix_def() (src/adventure/affix.rs:184-240); the live game server may override them via a gitignored adventure-item-balance.toml, so these are the modelled defaults, not a guarantee of what is running. Ruleset modeled: max 4 crafted mods per item + 1 Sacred, no unique affixes/shards, no krangle/reforge-crit/recombine-crit extras. Passive-tree magnitudes live alongside this file in passive-tree.json (generated from game/src/passive_tree.rs by tools/passive-tree-export.mjs).
audited: 2026-08-20 against PathofDust game/src/{adventure/character.rs,adventure/combat.rs,adventure/affix.rs,adventure/item.rs,passive_tree.rs} at commit 21c29d9 — re-audit vs 6b19e8f, three merges, all with real model impact. (1) feature/elementalist-design-intent-fixes: golem_summon_dmg_penalty was REMOVED from the codebase entirely, so 'golemDmgPenaltyPer' is gone from rules here and advisor-core no longer scales the owner's dps down by golem count; golems now inherit EVERY owner multiplier at full value (splash, lingering, righteousfire_pct, the Focus/Aegis trio — only atk/max_hp/evasion/damage_reduction/block_chance still scale to golemStatScale) and read the OWNER's live attack-speed stacks each turn, which together make advisor-core's existing 'golemStatScale × owner output' proxy accurate rather than the over-estimate it used to be. Righteous Fire's enemy-facing damage was re-homed out of its own periodic tick into an independent multiplicative layer inside resolve_hit (combat.rs:4260, raw_dmg *= 1 + righteousfire_pct), so it is now modeled as one more entry in classScore's layers — its SELF-burn is still unmodeled, see the ponytail note there. (2) feature/elemental-damage-all-slots: the 5 elemental damage affixes are eligible_slots: None now (affix.rs), so their 'slots' keys are dropped above — they plan on all 5 slots, and sum_affix reads all 5, so up to 5 independent elemental gear sources can stack. (3) feature/unified-unique-shards: currency/craft only, no combat effect (Celestial Shard merged into Unique Shard, which now opens an apply-time picker). ALSO FIXED, both pre-existing and both amplified by (2): elemProcDivisor was 50 where combat.rs:5401 says 10.0 (the 'elem' note below was corrected to 10.0 on 2026-08-19 but the value it documents was not), and advisor-core applied the Flame Golem multiplier to all 5 elements where combat.rs:10623-10626 applies it to fire/cold/lightning only. STANDING RISK: passive_overrides.rs lets the streamer retune any node's magnitude live, so a hardcoded value here can silently diverge from the running game — the site flags an overridden node with a 'Tuned:' span in its tooltip, which server.mjs scrapes as node.tuned.

Commoner.src: character.rs:100 — no bonus, level does nothing here

Elementalist.src: character.rs (2026-08-19) — ranged; root splash 0.15×(1+0.1×level) like Ranger, no baseline heal_power (healing earned through the Healing Flames tree). The golem branch IS scored (classScore's golem block: count and per-golem output share, Thunder absorb pool via the golemIncarnations proxy, Water regen + Replenishing, Flame Golem multiplying the owner's fire/cold/lightning gear increases) — no damage-penalty term any more, it was deleted from the game 2026-08-20. Righteous Fire is scored too since that same date, as a plain multiplicative layer (see src.righteousFire, including the live-override warning). Elemental procs stay per-fight sim, valued only through the procF proxy.

rules.splitPersonalityPoints: +1 for having it equipped, +1 more per full 300 tiers on the carrying item

src.sourceStacking: character.rs:794 combine_reduction_sources — capped 0-100% stats stack as 1-Π(1-s) across INDEPENDENT sources (gear+archetype is one source, the passive tree is another, Berserker's Reckless Swing/Death Wish taken penalty a third, Druid's Thorned Barrier+Ironbark a fourth). Gear alone caps at 75%; gear+tree reaches 93.75%; more sources push higher. Intervene is the exception: since 2026-08-18 its combined total is hard-capped at 50% (character.rs:2776), because two 50%-capped sources were reaching 75%. Evasion's own 95% clamp is applied at the resolve_hit roll, not on the stat. Growth stats (increased damage, max hp %, attack speed, crit, leech, splash, heal power) use the (1+gear)*(1+tree) form instead
src.overflow: character.rs:2445 defensive_overflow — DR/block/evasion/intervene past cap, GEAR+ARCHETYPE ONLY, feeds combat_increased_damage's gear layer 1:1. Passive OverflowConversion nodes (character.rs:2226) draw again from the COMBINED gear+tree overflow — a deliberate double-dip — each node capped at 0.10 × invested rank
src.inc: character.rs:2585 combat_increased_damage — (1+gear)*(1+tree)*(1+titansGrip)*(1+overwhelmingForce)*(1+momentousBlow)*(1+recklessSwing)*(1+deathWish)*(1+lifeTap) − 1, floored at −0.9. Every bespoke conversion is its own multiplicative layer
src.crit: combat.rs:3227 crit_stack_bonus — dmg × (1 + (min(stacks,1) + 1.5×over/(over+1))×(cm−1)×0.5), over = max(0, stacks−1); stacks = floor(chance)+Bernoulli(frac). Overcrit saturates: the bonus term caps at 2.5×(cm−1)×0.5. Crit chance = (0.05+gear+archetype)×(1+tree+deadeye); crit multiplier = (2+gear+archetype)×(1+tree)
src.mitigation: combat.rs:3865 resolve_hit — evasion is one roll (combined sources, .min(0.95)); block and DR are separate sources into combine_reduction_sources, so EV damage taken = (1−evasion)(1−DR)(1−block×blockReduction). blockReduction is 0.5, or Second Skin's 0.65/0.70/0.75
src.elem: proc chance = roll / ELEMENTAL_PROC_CHANCE_DIVISOR (10.0, combat.rs:5401), then chance.clamp(0.0, 1.0) at combat.rs:7170 — roll_elemental_proc, so an element past 10 raw buys nothing more on the proc side. This note said /50 with a stale line cite until 2026-08-19, and rules.elemProcDivisor itself was still 50 until the 2026-08-20 audit; the divisor has been 10.0 since the initial commit. The same roll is ALSO flat increased damage (character.rs:2588-2593) and that side is NOT clamped; elemental debuffs floor the target's defense at 25% and buffs ceiling it at 75%; lightning damage-taken stacks to 200%
src.splash: character.rs:2739 combat_splash = (1+gear)(1+tree)(1+primalForce) − 1, uncapped; combat.rs:6914 apply_splash — per-target share is min(splash,1) and it hits 2 extra targets, or 4 once splash exceeds 100%
src.divineLoop: combat.rs:4684-4696,6999 — healer divine self-buff: floor(raw%) guaranteed stacks, uncapped, 1% heal power each, 4s
src.healToSpeed: character.rs:2058-2071 — heal power excess over 100% divides the action interval, widened by Druid's Wild Surge + Overgrowth; 50ms floor. combat_hps clamps per-action heal size at 100% heal power, so excess buys frequency, not size
src.healPower: character.rs:2836 — (1 + base + archetype)(1 + tree)(1 + regrowth)(1 + bloomingField) − 1. Gear grants NO heal power since the 2026-08-15 rework retired the affix
src.linger: combat.rs:5673,4284-4297 — DoT/HoT = unmitigated hit × linger% over 80 ticks × 50ms = 4s, bypassing block, evasion and shields, flat-DR-only. combat_lingering_effect_pct = gear + evergrowth × healPower, and it fires off TOTAL output, damage and healing alike. As of 2026-08-18 the late-stage boss-damage penalty DOES apply to lingering ticks (and to every other true-damage path: reflect, Volatile Magic splash, Hemorrhage explosions, Doom's detonation) — see apply_late_stage_penalty
src.hp: character.rs:2006 — (20 + 5×level + bodyPower + flatLife) × (1 + archetype + incLife) × (1 + tree)
src.atk: character.rs:2018 — melee atk×2+4, ranged floor(atk×1.3)+2, heal floor(atk×0.8)+1, plus round(weapon power); atk = 5 + 2×level
src.helm: character.rs:2882 — helm power is dps added PER STACK every cooldown_ms; the sheet averages it over a 30s fight (half of duration/cooldown stacks)
src.leechCap: combat.rs:3057 — 20% maxHP/s, a leaky-bucket rolling window since 2026-08-18 (the old reset-based window let a leech build burst to ~2x the cap across the boundary). Slayer's Endless Thirst raises it, or removes it at rank 3, during a dash
src.sacred: item.rs:259-275,1286-1292 — 5th affix outside the craft cap, any affix any slot, 1.15×1.20 = 1.38× base, may duplicate
src.uniques: item.rs:96-147 — Celestial Conversion (10% of healing also hits / 10% follow-up strike) and Split Personality (a 2nd archetype tree plus bonus points). Excluded from the modeled ruleset
src.golems: combat.rs spawn_golem — golemStatScale (33%) applies ONLY to atk/max_hp/evasion/damage_reduction/block_chance; every other stat, multiplier and tree-passive effect the owner carries inherits at full value (risingphoenix_max_revives is the single deliberate exclusion). golem_summon_dmg_penalty — the old '33% less owner damage per summoned golem, additive' — was DELETED from the codebase on 2026-08-20 and is not modeled any more. Do not restore it from the game's own passive_tree.rs:1886 'golemmaster' node text, which still describes the penalty: that prose is stale in the source, passive-tree.json copies it verbatim on purpose so the overlay shows the player exactly what the game shows them, and the code is the authority. combat.rs golem_aware_effective_attack_interval — a golem's live speed multipliers are read off the OWNING Elementalist each turn (its own always evaluated to 1.0 before), so a golem swings at the owner's real cadence
src.righteousFire: combat.rs:4260 resolve_hit — righteousfire_pct (passive_node_magnitude('righteousfire'), 10/20/30%) is an independent multiplicative layer on every landed hit, splash included, the same shape as Conflagration. Before 2026-08-20 it was a separate per-second true-damage AoE tick instead; tick_righteous_fire still runs once a second but deals no damage of its own, only Relentless/Cauterizing Flames' debuffs and Ashes to Ashes' sweep. RF's SELF-burn is a separate tunable (rf_self_damage_pct_rank1/2/3, 10/20/30% of max HP per second, mitigated by DR then shields) and is NOT modeled — see the ponytail note in advisor-core's layers array. RESOLVED 2026-08-20: passive_overrides.rs had set righteousfire to 100/200/300 against a compiled default of 0.1/0.2/0.3, left over from when the value meant 'pct x max_hp of flat true damage per tick'. As a resolve_hit multiplier that same number was raw_dmg *= 301 at rank 3, compounding with crit, splash, elemental and golem inheritance, and it put Elementalist ~300x above every other class in the solved boards. The streamer has since retuned it to 0.5/1/1.5, and Elemental Focus and Scorching Flames lost their overrides entirely; a passive-tree-export run picked all three up and Elementalist DPS fell ~120x back into band, with no code change here — which is what should happen, since the model reads whatever the game reads
